parent: PR #7803 / A01 finite persistence model; predecessor retained unchanged
hypothesis: Identical local effect-marker/receipt bits can require different recovery classifications depending on independently known external-effect truth; absent local records alone cannot confirm non-occurrence.
test: Cross 3 effect-oracle states (occurred, not occurred, unavailable) with 2 local effect-marker values and 2 receipt values, plus an untrusted-record control. Compare the A01 bits-only classifier against an explicit-oracle classifier and an independent audit.
decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED if the strict candidate returns NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED only with independent negative effect truth and no contradictory records; otherwise UNKNOWN_RECONCILE, EFFECT_AND_RECEIPT_CONFIRMED only with independent positive truth plus receipt, and CORRUPT_OR_UNTRUSTED for contradictions/untrusted data. Auditor must reject every false-negative mutation.
scope: abstract finite classifier model only; no storage stack or external effect execution
